name: Ohio State University crystallography facility: TTP/SPT Labtech mosquito nano-volume pipetter (NIH S10; 2010)
brief: A university X-ray crystallography facility with no automation acquires a nanolitre-volume automated pipetter to set up many crystallisation trials from little protein sample.
